5.name: Founders' Day
5.overview: As Edgewater celebrates its annual Founders' Day festival, a catastrophic sinkhole opens beneath Main Street, trapping residents underground and forcing Station 42 into a high-stakes rescue. Meanwhile, a mysterious former firefighter arrives in Edgewater.

5.name: Fire Under Fire
5.overview: When a fast-moving wildfire threatens Edgewater, Station 42 and Three Rock battle increasingly dangerous conditions in an effort to contain the blaze. Meanwhile, as Bode works to connect with a newcomer carrying a complicated past, Sharon helps uncover a critical lead in an active investigation, setting the stage for unexpected consequences both on and off the fire line.

5.name: What Needs to Be Done
5.overview: As financial pressures continue to mount at Station 42, Bode fights to prove that Edgewater's new volunteer firefighting program can make a difference.

5.name: Winners and Losers
5.overview: As a mounting controversy puts Station 42 under scrutiny, Bode and the volunteer firefighters face a challenging test that leads them to an unexpected rescue.

5.name: No Way Out (II)
5.overview:
When escaped convicts trigger a dangerous manhunt, Bode and the Station 42 crew join forces with Sheriff Mickey Fox and her deputies to protect their loved ones and the community caught in the crossfire.

The crossover starts on Sheriff Country S02E05 No Way In (I).

5.name: Church and State
5.overview: When a dangerous electrical surge sparks a devastating fire at Eve's apartment complex, Station 42 races to save trapped residents, and they begin to question what is straining Edgewater's aging power grid.

overview: محکوم جوان، بود داناوان، به دنبال رستگاری و کاهش مدت حبس، به یک برنامه آتش‌نشانی می‌پیوندد که او را به زادگاه کوچکش در شمال کالیفرنیا بازمی‌گرداند، جایی که او و دیگر زندانیان در کنار آتش‌نشانان زبده برای خاموش کردن آتش‌سوزی‌های عظیم در سراسر منطقه تلاش می‌کنند.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Bode Donovan is a young convict with a troubled past. Hoping to redeem himself and shorten his prison sentence, he volunteers for the California Conservation Camp Program in which prisoners assist the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection, known as Cal Fire. He ends up getting assigned to his hometown in Northern California where he must work alongside former friends, other inmates, and elite firefighters putting out the huge fires that plague the region.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In the second season, Bode Donovan fights to clear his name and secure his early release from the Three Rock prison camp after taking the fall for a drug test to protect a fellow inmate. Once cleared and released, Bode ultimately chooses to leave his ex-girlfriend Gabriela's wedding to prioritize her happiness, seeking a new path as a free civilian and a legacy firefighter.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The third season centers on Bode Donovan’s pursuit of civilian firefighting and features chaotic personal arcs. The season opens with a massive helicopter crash interrupting Gabriela and Diego's wedding, immediately thrusting everyone into emergency response mode.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The fourth season centers on Station 42 and the Three Rock inmate firefighters as they navigate the devastating emotional fallout of losing beloved patriarch Vince Leone in a catastrophic memory care facility fire. With new leadership clashing with the crew and historic floods threatening Edgewater, the season focuses on Bode's continued pursuit of redemption, reconciling with his past, and finding closure.

title: Fire Country
